/-!
Planted by the trust self-test, plant V2c-B1 (B1 of ruling R-V10): a use of the
shadow token `(native_decide`, declared in `v2c-token-shadow-decl.lean.txt`. In
this module's own token table the token is absent, so `(native_decide)` reads as
`(`, the `native_decide` tactic and `)`, the tactic proves the goal and the
`example` leaves no constant. The gate, though, reads this source with the final
table, which holds `(native_decide`, so the bare word `native_decide` is never a
token the trust-token pass can see. Rule 2 of addendum V2c (token-table hygiene)
refuses the non-inert token.
-/

example : (2 : Nat) + 2 = 4 := by (native_decide)
